Question Choices: How many tenths are equal to 1.7?
Hints: One whole contains 10 tenths or 100 hundredths. Divide the amount by the named unit.
Solution: One tenth is 0.1. Count units: 1.7 / 0.1 = 17. Check: 17 x 0.1 = 1.7.
